_comment: Players ruled out for the rest of the season. fetch_rosters.py applies these to every roster entry it matches (by name, optionally constrained by team_afl), forcing injured=true + out_for_season=true + injury_desc=reason. This makes the exclusion durable regardless of keeperfantasy's weekly injuryStatus scrape, which can flip. app.js treats out_for_season as out in both projections and the lineup drawer. Match is on normalized name with the same nickname fuzzy-matching used for player resolution.
